lines.text: John the Baptist preached in the wilderness of Judea, calling people to repent because the kingdom of heaven was near.
John wore camel's hair and ate locusts and wild honey, and people were baptized by him in the Red Sea.
John told the Pharisees and Sadducees that God could raise up children for Abraham out of stones.
John said the One coming after him would baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire, and burn up the chaff.
Jesus came from Nazareth to be baptized by John, and a voice from heaven called Him beloved Son.
